# SpatialGames source collection

Imported 2026-10-03 from the user's Desktop/SpatialGames-sources collection, with 284 source files unchanged. See import-manifest.json for individual SHA-256 hashes and pinned revisions, and each project's original LICENSE. Collection provenance and historical reports are preserved in collection-records; obsolete paths in those reports are historical references.

The integrated Science Island classrooms live in lessons/spatial-games, with their adaptation boundaries in docs/spatial-games.md. Archived upstream entry pages may retain external dependencies and are not the classroom launch URLs. The new classrooms run locally without those external services. Soma's previously excluded optional analysis/libs/mermaid.js remains excluded; no further source download was performed. Original Desktop files were retained.
